SELECT FROM document_approval WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND document_id = #{documentId} AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT d.id AS dealId, d.name AS dealName, dd.id AS documentId, dd.title AS documentTitle, dd.version, a.requested_by AS requestedBy, a.created_at AS requestedAt FROM document_approval a JOIN deal d ON d.workspace_id = a.workspace_id AND d.id = a.deal_id JOIN deal_document dd ON dd.workspace_id = a.workspace_id AND dd.deal_id = a.deal_id AND dd.id = a.document_id WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.policy_id = #{policyId} AND a.status = 'pending' ORDER BY a.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document_approval WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND policy_id = #{policyId} AND status = 'pending'
mapper.update: UPDATE document_approval SET status = #{status}, decided_by = #{decidedBy}, decision_comment = #{decisionComment}, outcome_reason = #{outcomeReason}, outcome_detail = #{outcomeDetail}, decided_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'pending'
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.workspace_id, s.approval_id, s.step_order, s.name, s.required_count, s.status, s.decided_at, s.due_interval_hours, s.on_expiry, s.activated_at, s.due_at, s.escalated_at, s.reminded_round, s.created_at, s.updated_at, a.id AS approver_id, a.workspace_id AS approver_workspace_id, a.step_id AS approver_step_id, a.approver_kind, a.user_id AS approver_user_id FROM document_approval_step s LEFT JOIN document_approval_step_approver a ON a.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND a.step_id = s.id WHERE s.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND s.approval_id IN #{approvalId} ORDER BY s.approval_id, s.step_order, s.id, a.id

SELECT s.id, s.workspace_id, s.approval_id, s.step_order, s.name, s.required_count, s.status, s.decided_at, s.due_interval_hours, s.on_expiry, s.activated_at, s.due_at, s.escalated_at, s.reminded_round, s.created_at, s.updated_at, a.id AS approver_id, a.workspace_id AS approver_workspace_id, a.step_id AS approver_step_id, a.approver_kind, a.user_id AS approver_user_id FROM document_approval_step s LEFT JOIN document_approval_step_approver a ON a.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND a.step_id = s.id WHERE s.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND s.approval_id IN #{approvalId} ORDER BY s.approval_id, s.step_order, s.id, a.id FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, workspace_id, approval_id, step_id, decision, decided_by, comment, decided_at FROM document_approval_decision WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND approval_id IN #{approvalId} ORDER BY approval_id, step_id, id FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_approval_step ( workspace_id, approval_id, step_order, name, required_count, status, due_interval_hours, on_expiry, activated_at, due_at ) VALUES ( #{workspaceId}, #{approvalId}, #{stepOrder}, #{name}, #{requiredCount}, #{status}, #{dueIntervalHours,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{onExpiry,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CASE WHEN #{status} = 'active' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{status} = 'active' AND #{dueIntervalHours,jdbcType=INTEGER} IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR, #{dueIntervalHours,jdbcType=INTEGER}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE NULL END )
INSERT INTO document_approval_step_approver (workspace_id, step_id, approver_kind, user_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{stepId}, #{approverKind}, #{userId})
mapper.update: UPDATE document_approval_step SET due_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'active' AND activated_at IS NULL AND due_interval_hours IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR, due_interval_hours, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ELSE due_at END, activated_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'active' AND activated_at IS NULL THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE activated_at END, status = #{status}, decided_at = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('approved', 'rejected', 'cancelled', 'unsatisfiable', 'expired') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
UPDATE document_approval_step SET status = 'cancelled', decided_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND approval_id = #{approvalId} AND status IN ('pending', 'active')
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, approval_id, step_id, assignment_kind, assignment_round, approver_kind, user_id, delegated_by_user_id, created_by_user_id, comment, created_at FROM document_approval_step_assignment WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND approval_id IN #{approvalId} ORDER BY approval_id, step_id, id

SELECT id, workspace_id, approval_id, step_id, assignment_kind, assignment_round, approver_kind, user_id, delegated_by_user_id, created_by_user_id, comment, created_at FROM document_approval_step_assignment WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND approval_id IN #{approvalId} ORDER BY approval_id, step_id, id FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(assignment_round), 0) FROM document_approval_step_assignment WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND step_id = #{stepId} AND assignment_kind = 'reassignment' FOR UPDATE

SELECT id FROM document_approval_step WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND approval_id = #{approvalId} AND status = 'active' AND due_at IS NOT NULL AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP >= due_at ORDER BY step_order, id
mapper.update: UPDATE document_approval_step SET escalated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, due_at = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'active' AND escalated_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS stepId, s.reminded_round AS remindedRound, CASE WHEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP >= s.due_at THEN 3 WHEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP >= TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, FLOOR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, s.activated_at, s.due_at) * 0.9), s.activated_at) THEN 2 ELSE 1 END AS dueRound FROM document_approval_step s WHERE s.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND s.approval_id = #{approvalId} AND s.status = 'active' AND s.due_at IS NOT NULL AND s.reminded_round < 3 AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP >= TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, FLOOR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, s.activated_at, s.due_at) * 0.5), s.activated_at) ORDER BY s.step_order, s.id

SELECT a.id AS approvalId, a.deal_id AS dealId, d.name AS dealName, a.document_id AS documentId, dd.title AS documentTitle, dd.type AS documentType, dd.version AS version, s.id AS stepId, s.step_order AS stepOrder, s.name AS stepName, s.required_count AS requiredCount, s.due_at AS dueAt, s.escalated_at AS escalatedAt, a.requested_by AS requestedBy, a.created_at AS requestedAt FROM document_approval a JOIN document_approval_step s ON s.workspace_id = a.workspace_id AND s.approval_id = a.id JOIN deal d ON d.workspace_id = a.workspace_id AND d.id = a.deal_id JOIN deal_document dd ON dd.workspace_id = a.workspace_id AND dd.deal_id = a.deal_id AND dd.id = a.document_id WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.status = 'pending' AND s.status = 'active' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM document_approval_step_approver fa WHERE fa.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND fa.step_id = s.id AND (fa.approver_kind = 'any_approver' OR fa.user_id = #{userId})) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM document_approval_step_assignment sa WHERE sa.workspace_id = s.workspace_id AND sa.step_id = s.id AND (sa.approver_kind = 'any_approver' OR sa.user_id = #{userId}))) ORDER BY s.due_at IS NULL, s.due_at, a.id, s.step_order LIMIT #{limit}
